title: feat: sync Search Console performance to Tinybird daily
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Search Console keeps 16 months of search performance for `pollinations.ai`. This syncs it daily into Tinybird so the history is kept. Search terms only exist here.

**What we get** (property `sc-domain:pollinations.ai`, all subdomains, web search, per day)
- `totals`: clicks, impressions, CTR and position by country and device. True totals, including search terms Google hides for privacy
- `queries`: the same by search term, country and device
- `pages`: the same by page, country and device, for our own page routes only (Google indexes image URLs that contain prompts; those clicks still count in `totals`)

**What we don't get**: search terms Google hides for privacy (rare queries), who the searcher is, other search types (image, video, Discover).

**Changes**
- `search_console_raw`: API responses as returned (`dataset, date, start_row, fetched_at, body`). A report over 25,000 rows spans several responses (`start_row`). No pipe until we decide how to analyse it
- `data-sync-search-console-tinybird.yml`: daily at 05:45 UTC. Asks Google which days are final and syncs the latest three; days are sent again, the latest `fetched_at` wins. `days` input 1–7 for a missed run
- `operations/search-console/sync-to-tinybird.mjs`: `--dry-run` reads without writing. Requests compact JSON (`prettyPrint=false`), the same response without whitespace

The 16-month backfill is a one-off after merge and is not part of this PR.

**Keyless login**: GitHub's OIDC token is exchanged for a one-hour Google token (`google-github-actions/auth@v3`, `webmasters.readonly`). No secret is stored. Set up in the Myceli Google Cloud project `stellar-verve-465920-b7`:
- Service account `google-data-sync@stellar-verve-465920-b7.iam.gserviceaccount.com` (shared by the Google syncs), no key
- Workload identity pool `github`, provider `pollinations`, accepting only `pollinations/pollinations` on `main`
- Repository variables `GOOGLE_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER` and `GOOGLE_DATA_SYNC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` are set

gist.headline: Search history gets a nest
gist.blurb: Search Console's daily reports now have a place to roost in Tinybird. The raw data is saved for future analysis; the 16-month backfill is a separate job.
gist.summary: A 05:45 UTC workflow syncs the latest three finalized days of pollinations.ai Search Console totals, queries, and page reports into Tinybird's search_console_raw datasource, retaining daily search data beyond Search Console's 16-month window.
gist.impact: Maintainers get a growing raw record of clicks, impressions, CTR, and position by country and device, with search terms where Google provides them; analysis pipes and the one-off historical backfill are not included yet.
gist.visual_concept: Depict search-performance reports arriving as three dated pixel scrolls and being filed in a small bird-shaped data archive beside a CRT terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny archivist cap, helps the monitor robot sort them; code-plants and flowers make the archive feel like a growing garden.
